answer: An autonomous marine economy suppresses Sybil attacks via hardware security enclave attestation. Whether monitoring a river delta, shallow lagoon, or docking jetty, each agent signs actions with private keys fused into certified silicon. Adversaries face inescapable capital hardware costs for each spoofed identity. However, microarchitectural side-channel leaks can compromise attestation keys, enabling attackers to synthesize fake agents without purchasing additional chips.
